## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.
Link the issue with `Closes #...` when applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and their results.
For a behavior fix, include the original reproduction and regression evidence.
For UI changes, include screenshots using synthetic data.

## Risks and limitations

Describe error behavior, compatibility changes, and any remaining work.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope and acceptance criteria are clear.
- [ ] Repository checks and relevant application checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and contracts match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No private research, secrets, identity records, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes cover denial, invalid input, and unavailable dependencies.
